author: More Perfect Union
description:
Dr. Annie Andrews just flipped Senator Lindsey Graham's seat, and she did it by focusing on issues that working class Americans actually care about: health care, AI data centers, and ending pointless wars.

Dr. Andrews was backed by over 150,000 individual donors, and refused to take corporate money. Meanwhile her opponent was supported by Leading the Future PAC - funded by Marc Andreessen, Greg Brockman, and a co-founder of Palantir.

Host, Editor: @darincamponuevo
Producer: @trevorp_hayes
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How a Democrat won in deep-red South Carolina for the first time in 28 years
